samples.raw_completion:
module TopModule (
  input  [7:0] in,
  output [2:0] pos
);
  wire [7:0] masked;
  wire [2:0] first_high;
  assign masked = (in & 8'h01) ? 8'h01 :
                  (in & 8'h02) ? 8'h02 :
                  (in & 8'h04) ? 8'h04 :
                  (in & 8'h08) ? 8'h08 :
                  (in & 8'h10) ? 8'h10 :
                  (in & 8'h20) ? 8'h20 :
                  (in & 8'h40) ? 8'h40 :
                                  8'h80;
  assign first_high = (masked == 8'h01) ? 3'd0 :
                      (masked == 8'h02) ? 3'd1 :
                      (masked == 8'h04) ? 3'd2 :
                      (masked == 8'h08) ? 3'd3 :
                      (masked == 8'h10) ? 3'd4 :
                      (masked == 8'h20) ? 3'd5 :
                      (masked == 8'h40) ? 3'd6 :
                                          3'd7;
  assign pos = first_high;
endmodule
